land_banker_source: data/extras/competitor-builder-links.json (shared with the "Who banks whom" table), re-checked by the build's no-link rule

definitions.regional_heads_found: Named people at Regional level whose role is leading a region, area or group (level = Regional and role category = Regional President), counted once per builder. Region-level land, finance, sales and operations staff are not counted.
definitions.regions_listed: Regions, areas, groups or segments in each builder's own description of how it is organised (profile.regions).
definitions.regions_with_named_leader: Listed regions whose leader is named: the company's region list names one, or a mapped regional head's own title or geography names that region.
definitions.people_mapped: People rows after de-duplication within each builder.
definitions.land: People in a land acquisition, land development or other land role, at any level.
definitions.finance: People in a CFO, treasury / capital markets or other finance role, at any level.
definitions.land_heads_found: Builders with at least one land role at corporate level.
definitions.finance_heads_found: Builders with at least one CFO, treasury or finance role at corporate level.
definitions.builders_with_named_land_banker: Builders with at least one row that asserts a financing relationship with a named land banker or lot-option financier: the same links as the "Builder-financier links" and "Who banks whom" tables. Rows that record no link or only an indirect or people link, unnamed "land bank" arrangements, developers and affiliates are not counted. Each link keeps its confidence; some rest only on an Inferred source.
definitions.debt_instruments: Debt rows across all builders: notes, revolvers, term loans, warehouse lines, project debt.

how_built.label: Spine
how_built.text: The 2026 Builder 100 (ranked by 2025 closings), cross-checked against Pro Builder's 2026 list. The publisher blocks automated reads, so the list was read from the Internet Archive's copy of the publisher's page and is tagged Reported.

how_built.label: Research
how_built.text: About 200 research agents, one per builder part (leadership; division and regional leaders; financing and M&A), reading SEC filings, company sites and press releases, trade and local press, and state officer records. Every fact carries a source link, a retrieval date and a confidence tag. LinkedIn was never opened; no paywall was bypassed.

how_built.label: Regional heads
how_built.text: A second targeted pass on the 25 largest builders. 81 of 163 regions at those builders have a publicly named head.

how_built.label: Accuracy check
how_built.text: A fresh agent that did not do the research re-opened the sources for the highest-stakes rows on every builder: 1,299 rows checked, 1,199 held (92%), 51 corrected, 39 downgraded to Inferred, 10 removed.

how_built.label: Result
how_built.text: 100 builders, 2,105 people (342 land, 234 finance, 140 regional heads); 70.1% of people rows Verified; an average of 41.6 people per public builder against 15.1 per private builder; 22 builders with a publicly named land banker; 336 debt instruments.

how_built.label: Where the method ran out
how_built.text: (a) Some builders publish no one below their executive officers, so their regional heads are marked "not publicly disclosed" (for example NVR, Tri Pointe, and K. Hovnanian's group presidents). (b) Filings report land banking in aggregate and rarely name the land banker, so counterparties are named for only 22 builders. (c) Private builders disclose almost nothing about financing. (d) Names seen only in third-party directories or search snippets are kept as leads and tagged Inferred. (e) State-level volumes are not public, so geography is by presence, not by size.
